_comment: Your calendar. Nothing fetches this - you own it. The dashboard shows a rolling window from today, so past events drop off on their own and you only ever add.

_how_to_add.when: ISO with offset: 2026-08-11T17:00:00-04:00. The -04:00 is US Eastern in summer (EDT); use -05:00 from Nov to Mar (EST). Bangkok time is worked out for you. For an all-day event write just 2026-08-13.
_how_to_add.kind: one of: earnings, macro, fed, company, other
_how_to_add.status: confirmed = company IR or official agency said so. estimated = an aggregator's guess, or your own. conflicting = sources disagree.
_how_to_add.tickers: optional list, links the event to names in your umbrella
_how_to_add.note: optional - why you care. This is the part worth writing.

events.title: NVIDIA Q2 FY27 earnings
events.note: Guided ~$91.0B +/-2%; consensus ~$91.85B, only ~0.9% above the midpoint. A modest beat is close to priced - the reaction hangs on the Q3 guide, Blackwell Ultra execution and gross-margin durability. Reads across the whole umbrella. Results ~13:20 PT, call 14:00 PT. Note it lands the night before Jackson Hole opens.

events.title: PCE price index (July) - Personal Income and Outlays
events.note: BEA, the Fed's actual target measure rather than CPI. Sources put this in the Aug 26-28 window; confirm on bea.gov. Feeds directly into the hawks' case at Jackson Hole two days later.

events.title: Marvell Q2 FY27 earnings
events.note: Not in the umbrella, but the cleanest read-across to ALAB and CRDO on custom silicon and interconnect demand. Data centre was 76% of revenue last quarter. Marvell has also set an Investor Day for Oct 6.

events.title: Jackson Hole - Warsh keynote
events.note: Symposium runs Aug 27-29; the Friday keynote is the market event. Warsh's first as Chair. He has curtailed forward guidance and shortened statements since May, and has pre-framed this as structural rather than near-term - so the setup favours disappointment for anyone expecting a September signal. The harder signal is already on the record: July's FOMC was 9-3 to hold, with Hammack, Kashkari and Logan dissenting for an immediate HIKE. Time approximate; KC Fed publishes the agenda the evening before.

events.title: Employment Situation (August) - non-farm payrolls
events.note: BLS. Last payrolls print before the Sept FOMC.

events.title: US markets closed - Labor Day
events.note: No US session. Dashboard will show Friday's close; the workflow runs but finds nothing new.

events.title: CPI (August)
events.note: BLS. Final inflation read before the FOMC five days later.

events.title: US Senate reconvenes
events.note: Recessed Aug 8, returns Sept 14 with roughly three weeks of floor time before the midterm campaign break. That window is the whole runway left for CLARITY in 2026.

events.title: CLARITY Act - Senate cloture vote
events.note: PROCEDURAL, not final passage. Cloture on the motion to proceed - needs 60 votes just to begin formal debate. Republicans hold 53 seats, so ~7 Democrats must cross. Thune filed cloture before the recess. House passed H.R.3633 on 17 Jul 2025 (294-134); Senate Banking advanced it 15-9 on 14 May 2026. Blocking issues are ethics/conflict-of-interest language and illicit-finance safeguards; a Tillis-Gallego ethics proposal was sitting with the White House. Polymarket had 2026 signing odds down near 17% in early August. Even if cloture clears, House and Senate texts must still be reconciled - possibly via conference - before anything reaches the President. Lands 1-2 days before the FOMC.

events.title: FOMC decision + Summary of Economic Projections
events.note: Sept 15-16 meeting, dot plot quarter. Hike-or-hold odds were near even in mid-August - unusual, and worth noting the risk here is a HIKE, not a cut. Half the committee penciled in hikes for 2026 back in June. Lands 01:00 Bangkok on the 17th.

events.title: BOJ policy decision
events.note: Sept 17-18 meeting, decision day two. Held at 1.0% in July on an 8-1 vote, Takata dissenting for 1.25%. No fixed release time; statement usually midday JST, presser 15:30 JST. Watch USD/JPY, then JGBs. Falls the day after the FOMC - the two compound rather than resolve separately.

events.title: Micron Q4 FY26 earnings
events.note: Sources split across Sept 22, 23 and 29 - confirm on Micron IR closer to the date. The memory-cycle checkpoint, and it sits right in the stated Sept-Oct exit window.

events.title: Marvell Investor Day
events.note: Guidance framework rather than one quarter. Read-across to the connectivity bucket.

events.title: FOMC decision
events.note: Oct 27-28, no dot plot. Inside the exit window and one week before the midterms.
